summary: OneConstruction Group Ltd (issuer) filed a Form 6-K to disclose the resignation of Executive Director Cheung Kam Cheung, effective April 8, 2026, and the subsequent appointment of Dr. Michael He as a director on July 3, 2026. The appointment fills the board vacancy. Dr. He will receive annual cash compensation of HK$120,000 (~US$15,300). The filing does not constitute a routine annual meeting notice; it reports a board-level change arising from a resignation, making it a non-routine management event. No other special-situations terms were disclosed. The resignation and appointment are effective immediately, with no regulatory escrow or conditions. What to watch: potential further board changes or strategic shifts under Dr. He's high-tech background.
